name: Agency hero: a working file inspector over the handover, where the owner field reads You on all eight items
notes: Signature effect: a real two-pane inspector over the eight things handed to a client (domain, hosting, Google Business Profile, source, credentials, original photos, analytics, invoice). The quiet payload is that the Owner row reads 'You' on every single one, and the visitor discovers that by clicking rather than being told. Directly answers the most common way a small business gets hurt by a web person, which is that the web person holds the domain. Built as a real ARIA listbox using aria-activedescendant, so focus stays on the list container while assistive tech is told which of eight is current; moving real focus into each row would fight the arrow key handling. Arrow keys, Home and End all work, and the selected row is scrolled into view when arrowing past the visible area. On mobile the panes stack and the list keeps a 178px cap so eight rows of filenames cannot push the detail off the bottom of a phone. Part of the ten hero 940Digital brand series (sections 0027 to 0036); the series log, the contact sheet that renders all ten live, and the written recommendation are in brand-heroes/set-evidence/. Unlike the client-derived sections in this library, this one is NOT de-identified: 940Digital is Owen's own business, so there is no third party to protect and the real wordmark, palette and copy are the point of the section. Brand rules baked in across the whole series: display type at weight 500 with about -0.03em tracking (not 700); #3194E0 never carries text on a light background because it measures 2.90:1, so blue text on sand is #1F6FB0 and a blue fill takes a charcoal label at 5.18:1; every figure is JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums; text containers are sized in ch, not px.
